{{Top|leg}}
'''Link armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], around the events of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Link armor connected small insulated rings together to create a heavy protective covering that was capable of protecting the wearer against both physical and energy attacks.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Link armor was designed to connect with another, larger set of link armor to create a heavier and more protective covering. However, the double suit modification was bulkier and the wearer was less agile while wearing it.<ref name="GFT" />

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] favored using link armor when entering battle,<ref name="GFT" /> including [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. [[ProTech]] manufactured a set of link armor called the [[SupraLink]]. Each set cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
